Job Announcement --> BTDC-ID: 41593 Closing Date: 09-Oct-2026 Announcement Positions IT Intern Contact Details Office Address ANINA Building 6th Floor, No 240, St. 271, B.P600, 12351, Sangkat Boeng Tumpun, Khan Mean Chey, Phnom Penh, Cambodia   Contact Name TotalEnergies Marketing (Cambodia) Co., Ltd.   Email TO: sm-kh.hr@totalenergies.com   Website kh.totalenergies.com   Announcement Description TotalEnergies Marketing (Cambodia) Co., Ltd. (previously called TOTAL Cambodge) is an affiliate of TotalEnergies, a broad energy company that produces and markets energies on a global scale: oil and biofuels, natural gas and green gases, renewables and electricity. Our 105,000 employees are committed to energy that is ever more affordable, clean, reliable and accessible to as many people as possible. Active in more than 130 countries, TotalEnergies puts sustainable development in all its dimensions at the heart of its projects and operations to contribute to the well-being of people. TotalEnergies Marketing (Cambodia) Co., Ltd. has been officially operating in Cambodia since 1993. Throughout the country, TotalEnergies Marketing (Cambodia) Co., Ltd. has been involved in marketing various energy and lubricants products and services to its customers in both the private and public sectors. We offer a wide range of products through more than 130 service stations with over 91 Bonjour Shops, Industrial fuels, Aviation fuels and Lubricants. Through the Mobility Solutions, Fleet management is the latest and very advanced system, fully secured and easy to control fully online and these multi-service cards support the mobility of our business customers nationwide. In view of supporting its growth in Cambodia, TotalEnergies Marketing (Cambodia) Co., Ltd. is looking for a talented and motivated candidate for the position as follow: Announcement Positions IT Intern Apply Now --> Workplace Circumstances Environment: Office Languages: English Location: Phnom Penh Position Circumstances Career Category: Internship, Computer - General, Computer - Networking Schedule: Full-time Salary: N/A Type : Job Opportunity --> Position Summary Reporting Line : IT Manager Period of intern: 6 months up to 1 year with monthly allowance provided Duties & Responsibilities: Oversee the day-to-day operation of computer hardware, software, and network for TEMC and other local companies (CamDiS, Total Solar, SCDF, Total E&P) General troubleshooting on IT related matter such as computer hardware, software, and network Provide service support on computer hardware such as laptop, desktop, printer, ups, EPT, WiFi AP, network switch/ router, computer staging, App installation on PC, patch deployment, Lift on Mobile devices, Outlook E-mail, OASiS, SAP, TemC+, ClearView, TEAMs, SharePoint, and OS Dealing with TGITS on the service request ticket for newcomer and other related IT issue Other tasks may be assigned by IT Manager. Expected Profile of Candidates Languages: English - Good Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or others related field is encouraged to apply Skills & Knowledge: General & Technical Skills Skill: Good proficiency of English for both writing and speaking, knowledge of IT helpdesk, IT hardware and software maintenance and troubleshooting Knowledge: MS Office, Internet and Email proficiency Language: Good proficiency of English for both writing and speaking. Soft Skills Willing to learn, honest and be able to work under pressure   How to Apply Applications should be submitted via email or to our Head Office provided in the contact details.
